title: OPEC+ ministerial meeting (December quotas)
source: EST: cadence read off the seven participating countries' own primary. opec.org/pr-detail/1835613-6-september-2026.html, re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200), states verbatim 'The seven OPEC+ countries will continue to hold monthly meetings to review market conditions' and closes with 'The next meeting will be held on 4 October 2026.' The observed cadence is the FIRST SUNDAY of each month, 5 for 5 on the record and each date named verbatim in the prior release — 2026-06-07, 2026-07-05, 2026-08-02, 2026-09-06, 2026-10-04 — and the first Sunday of November 2026 is 2026-11-01. NO SOURCE NAMES A NOVEMBER DATE: the 09-06 release names only 10-04, and a targeted search for a published November date returned nothing, so this is a cadence projection and is labelled as one. Filed estimate on three counts, none of which is doubt about the cadence: market-events-data.ts defines no trusted source prefix for opec.org, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and the date itself is projected rather than published. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Proposed by the jobs-2026-11-06 D-58 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-09), which found it five sessions ahead of that print and on the channel that now dominates its corridor: the 09-08 strikes on Saudi energy facilities and a reported second Iranian salvo at US Navy ships put Brent above $99, while average hourly earnings printed +3.1% y/y, the softest since mid-2021 — so the live inflation impulse into the November corridor is supply-side energy, and this is the only dated forum that can act on it between the 10-04 meeting and the 11-06 payroll print. Impact `medium` mirrors opec-plus-meeting-2026-09-06 and opec-plus-meeting-2026-10-04 and reflects the base case (another monthly non-decision, with Q4 output reportedly paused), not the consequence if the group responds to a war premium it did not create. Corridor placement is the reason this was proposed on cadence rather than passed over: 11-01 is two days before the midterms (11-03) and five before payrolls (11-06), inside a window that also carries the November refunding auctions (3Y 11-09, 10Y 11-10) and a four-event 11-10 session. SHADOWED ON SIGHT: the opec-plus-meeting-2026-10-04 lane owns the canonical file and will write it off that meeting's own verbatim next-meeting sentence, which is a published date rather than a projection — this proposal exists only so the corridor is not silent about 11-01 in the meantime.
